run_progress_monitor: run the InferenceProgressMonitor PipelineStep to monitor dataset generation progress and update the dataset card
count_documents_in_repo: count documents in uploaded parquet files in a HuggingFace dataset repository without downloading data
calculate_eta: calculate estimated time remaining and completion datetime based on completed documents and elapsed time
render_progress_bar: render a progress bar with ETA showing filled dots, percentage, document counts, and completion time
patch_readme_progress: patch an existing README with updated progress bar and timestamp for a specific dataset config
